manifest.title: FediShare Gateway
manifest.tagline: Stable ActivityPub address for FediShare desktop nodes
manifest.description:
FediShare Gateway gives desktop FediShare nodes a stable ActivityPub address.

It is a rendezvous service, not a file host. The container stores usernames, public keys, and a small Actor/WebFinger cache under `/app/data`. Private keys and shared files stay on the user's computer.

After install, set `gateway_url` on the desktop app to this location's HTTPS origin.
manifest.changelog:
* Initial Cloudron package for fedishare-gateway
* HTTP/1.1 Upgrade tunnel, challenge-response auth, cached Actor/WebFinger when the node is offline
manifest.postInstallMessage: Set **gateway_url** on the FediShare desktop app to this location's HTTPS origin (no trailing slash). The private key never leaves the desktop.

desktop-gateway-url.message: On the FediShare desktop app, set **gateway_url** to this location's HTTPS origin (the Cloudron domain). The private key never leaves the desktop.
